partners.mechanism_chain: NOP10 (HGNC:18056) —BINDS→ H/ACA RNP complex assembly (GO:0000363); SHQ1 (HGNC:10570) —BINDS→ H/ACA RNP complex assembly (GO:0000363); H/ACA RNP complex assembly (GO:0000363) —DISRUPTS→ Ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254); H/ACA RNP complex assembly (GO:0000363) —DISRUPTS→ RNA processing (GO:0006396); Ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254) —LEADS_TO→ Dyskeratosis congenita (HP:0001032); RNA processing (GO:0006396) —LEADS_TO→ Dystonia (HP:0001312); RNA processing (GO:0006396) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); Ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental disorder (HP:0012444); RNA processing (GO:0006396) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental disorder (HP:0012444). Loss-of-function mutations in NOP10 and SHQ1 disrupt the assembly and function of H/ACA ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complexes. These complexes are essential for ribosome biogenesis and various RNA processing events.
